content.short: Alto bundler is an infrastructure platform for building next-generation Smart Wallets, including ERC-4337 support.
content.description: Alto bundler provides the essential components for ERC-4337 wallet development: bundlers that assemble and submit user operations, verifying paymasters that validate each operation, and ERC-20 paymasters that enable gas payments with ERC-20 tokens. These tools work together to help you build wallets that are more stable and reliable while enabling faster iteration during development. Use Alto bundler to streamline account abstraction work and explore gas-sponsorship patterns and user-initiated workflows.
content.meta: Alto bundler is an infrastructure platform for building the next generation of Smart Wallets. Discover Alto bundler and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
